title: Service Contracts: renewal notice period and renewal performance level by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference gives the two renewal figures of the Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts tiers: how many calendar days before the current contract's expiry a renewal offer on the same trade lane may be issued, and what share of its commitment the current contract must have lifted for a renewal at the same or a higher tier.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Renewal offer may be issued from (calendar days before expiry) | Volume lifted needed for same-or-higher renewal (% of the commitment) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 60 | 80 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 60 | 80 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 90 | 85 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 90 | 85 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 120 | 90 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 120 | 90 |

The renewal notice figure is a whole number of calendar days before the current expiry date. The performance figure is a whole percent of the current contract's minimum quantity commitment, measured as volume lifted.

## Worked conversions (hypothetical commitments)
| Current tier | Hypothetical commitment | Performance level | Volume lifted needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 200 FEU | 80 % | 160 FEU |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 1000 FEU | 85 % | 850 FEU |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 3000 FEU | 90 % | 2700 FEU |

Each figure is the commitment multiplied by the tier's percent and divided by one hundred.

## Quick questions
**How early may a renewal offer be issued for an AHL Regional Account Contract?** From 90 calendar days before the current expiry date.

**Does a higher tier ask for a higher performance level?** Across the ladder the figure rises from 80 % (Starter and Standard) to 85 % (Regional Account and Key Account) and 90 % (Global Account and Strategic Partner).
